page_title: SAS 4-2 JUV | Sassuolo v Juventus 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+5' 4 - 2 Federico Gatti (Juventus) gets on the scoresheet, but unfortunately for him it's an own goal.
90+3' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' Alessio Dionisi prepares a substitution. Matias Vina is replaced by Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo).
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' One of the Sassuolo players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
85' The game has come to an end for Armand Lauriente. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo).
85' Andrea Pinamonti comes off the pitch to be replaced by Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo).
85' Substitution. Nedim Bajrami did his best and is replaced by Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo).
84' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Manuel Locatelli will be replaced by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).
83' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) picks up a yellow card.
82' 3 - 2 Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 3:2.
78' 2 - 2 Goal! Nicolo Fagioli plays it to Federico Chiesa (Juventus), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Alessio Cragno. 2:2.
76' Substitution. Moise Kean (Juventus) has come on for Dusan Vlahovic.
73' The ball is out of play and Sassuolo manage to earn a corner.
71' A quickly taken corner by Sassuolo.
69' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

69' The ball is cleared after Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
68' Timothy Weah (Juventus) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
67' The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
65' Close! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
64' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

63' A precise short pass from Domenico Berardi releases Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
63' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Timothy Weah (Juventus) replaces Weston McKennie.
59' A VAR review has confirmed it's nothing more than a yellow card for Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo).

59' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo), but referee Andrea Colombo must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
58' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is given a yellow card.
57' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) leaps to collect the ball.

56' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
55' This is a yellow card! Danilo (Juventus) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
54' The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
53' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) shoots from the free kick, but his good effort flies just wide of the left post.
52' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes a direct free kick.
52' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
50' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sassuolo.
47' Here comes a substitution. Ruan Tressoldi is given a rest as he is replaced by Mattia Viti (Sassuolo).
46' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Fabio Miretti and he is replaced by Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus).
46' A substitution has been made. Filip Kostic goes off and Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) comes on.
46' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Juventus, play can continue.
45' Referee Andrea Colombo makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Juventus. Let’s see what happens!
44' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Juventus was in an offside position.
44' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
41' 2 - 1 Goal! Matheus Henrique tees up Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
40' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
38' The referee signals a corner kick to Sassuolo.
37' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
36' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
34' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Wojciech Szczesny.
33' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) trips an opposition player and Andrea Colombo signals a foul.
31' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
29' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is first to the rebound and attempts to beat the keeper from long range. It's a decent effort, but flies just wide of the right post.
26' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and it's Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' Great teamplay by Juventus as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
21' 1 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Matias Vina (Sassuolo), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
17' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
17' Juventus control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

12' 1 - 0 Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) latches on to a brilliant pass and hits a poor shot towards the middle of the goal, but the ball goes into the back of the net after the goalkeeper makes a howler!
10' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
8' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
7' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) attempts to find Dusan Vlahovic, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
6' Sassuolo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Federico Chiesa sends the free kick into the box. Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it high over the bar.
3' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) will take the free kick.
2' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) tackles a bit over-zealously and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andrea Colombo.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
